strings.ht_tip_lpg: Book the next refill the day you switch to the spare cylinder. Check the date on your gas hose and replace it every 5 years.
strings.ht_tip_puc: Driving without a valid PUC certificate can get you fined. Renew a few days early.
strings.ht_tip_vehicle_insurance: Renew before it lapses – a gap in cover can mean a fresh inspection and losing your no-claim bonus.
strings.ht_tip_electricity: Setting the AC to 26°C and switching off appliances at the plug cuts the bill noticeably.
strings.ht_tip_ro_filter: A clogged filter makes water taste flat and strains the pump – change it on time.
strings.ht_tip_water_cans: Keep one full can spare so you're never caught out on a holiday.
strings.ht_tip_smoke_alarm: Test the alarm every month and change batteries once a year.
